features: Supported cameras: DirectIP, AXIS, PANASONIC, ONVIF
Transmission speed: 400Mbps / 500Mbps (BRP Mode)
Recording compression: H.265, H.264
Client connection: Gigabit Ethernet (Client) x1
Video in connection: Gigabit Ethernet(Video In) x3, SFP(Video In ) x 2
Trigger events: Alarm In, Audio Detection, Motion Detection, Trip-zone, Tampering, Video Loss, Text-in, ANPR, Etc.
Playback: 16ch Full HD synchronous playback 4ch 4K playback
Operating system: Embedded Linux
Certifications: FCC, UL, CE, CB, KC, PSE
Expandable up to 240TB using eSATA storage
Supports RAID redundant power
Establish NVR Failover system with standby DR-8364F(D)
Supports IDLA events with AI metadata Search (via IDIS Center, IDIS Solution Suite)
Supports BI analytics and events with VA Dashboard (via IDIS Center, IDIS Solution Suite)
Audio outputs: 1 RCA, 1 HDMI
Audio and alarm I/O from IP cameras: 64 / 64 (depending on IP camera)
Alarm reset input: 1
Serial interface: RS232 (terminal block), RS485 (terminal block)
USB: 2 x USB 2.0, 1 x USB 3.0
notes: DR-8364D page states power consumption as 120W (with 8 HDDs); DR-8364(F)D page states 100-240V~, 50/60Hz, 2.0-1.0A, 120W x2. Power consumption left out.
DR-8364D page states max. recording throughput as 400Mbps, 1920ips@Full HD, 240ips@4K (UHD); DR-8364(F)D page states 400Mbps, 1920ips@UHD.
Alarm, audio and USB values are taken from the DR-8364(F)D product page.
The failover, IDLA and BI items are stated on the DR-8364(F)D page only.
